evidence: Procedure per quality-checks.md section 3. (1) Spelling: extracted the unique lowercase word set of instruction.md + both /instructions notes and reviewed every token; no misspellings found (unusual tokens like 'undoable', 'overfill', 'mid-reply', 'server-sent', 'trampled' are legitimate). No doubled words (regex \b(\w+) \1\b: no hits). All three files are pure ASCII, LF, no mojibake. (2) Placeholders/notes: grep for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|placeholder|TBD|<word>|C:\\|/Users/|/home/|F:/|.qc|golden|rubric|judge over all three files: zero hits; the template's 'CHANGE_ME: write the task prompt the agent receives.' has been fully replaced. No author asides or duplicated paragraphs. (3) Paths: only intended runtime paths appear (/app, /app/server.js, /app/app.db, /assets/seed_data.json, /instructions/hireops_rules.md, /instructions/integration.md, /api/health, /app/node_modules); no developer-machine paths. (4) Contradictions cross-checked: one password 'Hireops!2026' (instruction.md:17, hireops_rules.md:11); one account list (instruction.md:17) matching seed users exactly (3 recruiters, 3 hiring managers, 1 observer, 3 candidates with the same emails and roles); one seed path; port 3000 + PORT (instruction.md:13) vs 'listens on port 3000 on 0.0.0.0' (integration.md:5) compatible; DB_PATH/app.db agree across instruction.md:13, integration.md:7-8, rules:201; 15 seconds agrees (instruction.md:5 'fifteen seconds', rules:117 '15 seconds'); page size 30 agrees with seed thread_page_size=30; candidate wording table (rules:183-190) matches seed candidate_status_labels; interview limits in seed fall within the stated 1-50; no fixed clock is stated anywhere, so no clock conflict. Undo: instruction.md:3 'as long as nobody has touched those cards since' is refined, not contradicted, by rules:98-99 (moved/re-ordered/rejected/reopened; 'Adding a note does not count as a change'). Plausible-failure probe: a model reading the brief cannot be misled into a wrong product by any stray text or competing value; a conforming app is not penalized by any instruction contradiction found here. Notes (non-defects): mixed dialect - instruction.md:13 'honour'/'honouring' (British) vs integration.md:7 'honoring' (template text) and rules:201 'Honor'; these are valid spellings, not errors. hireops_rules.md is otherwise hard-wrapped near 104 cols but lines 99, 112, 173, 180 run 111-169 chars and line 91 breaks early ('rules above,') - cosmetic editing residue, not pasted contamination. Integration.md adds a task-specific delivery paragraph (lines 16-19, symlinks/NODE_PATH) beyond the template text; it is coherent and not contamination (template-control is another row's concern). Deterministic checkers check-instruction-hygiene/content were not executed by me; this is a manual source review only.
